title: Ian Stevenson's reincarnation cases at the University of Virginia
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Ian Stevenson's reincarnation cases at the University of Virginia, about 1960s-1980s at University of Virginia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Stevenson, Dr. Ian Stevenson studied got hundreds and hundreds of cases of children who spontaneously remembered past lives.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that Dr. Ian Stevenson, a researcher at the University of Virginia, gathered hundreds and hundreds of cases of young children who suddenly remembered past lives. He places this work from the 1960s through the 1980s. He tells it as evidence that the mind may outlive the body, which would change how we think about death.
